senses.example: Este chorizo es demasiado picante para mí.
senses.exampleGloss: This chorizo is too spicy for me.

alternatives.reason: General intensity of flavour, not specifically heat.
The "spicy" sense of a joke: un chiste verde.

notes: Invariable in gender: un plato picante, una salsa picante. Standard in Peninsular Spanish.
